title: Drive and safety features
summary: Feedback centers on liking the car’s features, driving assistance, and safety-related tech, while many other mentions simply note features without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the overall feature set, safety features, driving assistance, and the pleasant driving experience alongside those features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention features or safety features in a descriptive way, often noting that owners are still learning or exploring them without stating approval or dislike.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are brief and generic references to features, which limits detail about specific functions or use cases.
Undetermined mentions make up a large portion of the topic, so many examples do not express a clear opinion.
The topic blends general features, safety features, and driving assistance, and the examples do not always distinguish clearly among them.
